input.subject: The Chelsea Monthly — August rates, trends & one to watch
input.bodyText:
Welcome to this month's edition of The Chelsea Monthly.

MORTGAGE RATES: The 30-year fixed ticked down slightly this month to around 6.3%, the third consecutive decline. Many buyers who paused in the spring are quietly re-entering the market to lock in before any autumn volatility.

MARKET TRENDS: Downtown inventory remains tight, with well-priced 1BRs still moving in under three weeks. We're seeing bidding activity return to prewar co-ops in particular, while newer condo product is sitting a bit longer as buyers weigh carrying costs.

AROUND THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Save the date — the annual Chelsea Art Walk returns the third weekend of September. A great chance to see the galleries after hours.

FEATURED NEW EXCLUSIVE: 240 West 23rd St, #4C, Chelsea — 1BR/1BA, $875,000, low CC, prewar. Reply for a private showing.

Until next month,
Alexandra
